name: Textarea
purpose: Multi-line text entry — the Input-fields boxed state channel stretched vertically. Vertical-only resize, live counter that warns by weight (never colour-alone) at 90% of the limit with polite announcements. Itinerary row 20 (P1); built Phase-2 wave 1.

props.name: maxlength
props.$note: Drives the counter; remaining count announced politely at 90% and at the limit.

props.name: rows
props.$note: Initial height; min-height 96px (4px grid), user resize vertical-only.

tokens.type: .t-ed-body on the textarea (multi-line 16/24) · .t-cm-label label · .t-ed-body-small help · .t-cm-legal counter

behaviour.resize: vertical only (horizontal resize breaks the layout grid); disabled turns resize off.
behaviour.counter: n/max updates on input; is-warn (weight 500) at ≥90%; aria-live region announces remaining at 90% and at the limit.

accessibility.label: Real <label for>; help + counter joined via aria-describedby.
accessibility.counter: Visual counter aria-hidden is avoided — the live region carries the announcement so the count is not read on every keystroke (4.1.3 Status Messages, polite).
accessibility.errors: aria-invalid + ink message with rag roundel (1.4.1 Use of Colour).

antiPatterns: Colour-only counter warning (weight change + announcement, never colour-alone).
Red error message text (message stays ink).
Auto-growing height without a max (the page must not scroll-jump as the user types).

tokenValidation.result: PASS — new build, no deprecated tokens: live form/* chrome, R-D20 error set, control radius role, composite type throughout.

provenance.$note: Itinerary row 20 (P1), Phase-2 wave 1 worker A. Pattern-matches gated Input-fields exactly (per the brief); Tranche-6 textarea = structural prior art (ruling 3). No dedicated Figma node bound yet.
